author: ETA PRIME
description:
we are taking a first look at the all-new Anbernic RG DS Plus. As the follow-up to last year's original Android-based RG DS, Anbernic has completely redesigned this system to give us the ultimate clamshell retro gaming experience!

https://anbernic.com/products/rg-ds-plus?sca_ref=2193181.CeT6UNbFuN

This new version drops Android in favor of a highly optimized Linux OS and sizes up the displays to massive dual 4.3-inch IPS screens running at a crisp 1024x768 resolution. This gives you a flawless 4x integer scale for native DS titles! Complete with a built-in capacitive stylus, an integrated microphone for those tricky DS mechanics, and an upgraded stepless alloy hinge, this sub-$100 handheld is a total game-changer for Nintendo DS emulation.
